bookingTiming: At least 3 working days before departure; check in at least 2 hours before departure.
bookingMethod: Request AVIH through a Thai Airways sales office or contact centre; other species and ineligible consignments must be arranged through Thai Cargo.
Contact EVA Air and obtain acceptance before travel; complete the required live-animal declaration.

bookingTiming: Contact Singapore Airlines at least 2 weeks before departure.
bookingMethod: Contact the local Singapore Airlines office before booking is finalised; carriage must remain entirely on Singapore Airlines-operated flights.

bookingTiming: Submit the pet travel form at least 1 week before travel and complete booking and payment before departure.
bookingMethod: Submit Emirates' online pets travel form; Emirates confirms whether the itinerary is eligible for checked baggage or must be handled by Emirates SkyCargo.

bookingTiming: Request between 2 and 30 days before departure and no later than 48 hours before the intended flight.
bookingMethod: Contact Qatar Airways and submit the live-animal request form; inbound transfer from another airline is not accepted.

bookingTiming: Submit the booking form at least 7 days before travel; provide required documents at least 72 hours before travel and arrive 3 hours before departure.
bookingMethod: Book an Etihad-operated itinerary, then submit the Pets Onboard booking form and await confirmation before travel.

bookingTiming: Register online at least 72 hours before departure; Lufthansa states that its Service Center may still accept a request until 24 hours before departure if capacity remains.
bookingMethod: Register each animal with Lufthansa and wait for confirmation; transport is limited to Lufthansa-operated flights and accepted routes.

bookingTiming: Reserve no later than 48 hours before departure; earlier booking is recommended because capacity is limited.
bookingMethod: Reserve through My Trip or contact the KLM Customer Contact Centre. Hold carriage is unavailable when a transfer exceeds three hours.

bookingTiming: The online pet service may be purchased until six hours before departure, subject to quota; earlier booking is recommended.
bookingMethod: Add the pet while buying or managing the ticket online, or contact Turkish Airlines; each flight is subject to pet quota and operational confirmation.

bookingTiming: For a hold pet, book the journey at least seven days before departure and notify Finnair within 24 hours of booking. Cabin space should be added when booking or confirmed immediately afterward.
bookingMethod: Use Finnair's booking flow or customer service. Hold carriage requires a Finnair- or Norra-operated itinerary and a Helsinki connection of at least three hours.

bookingTiming: No public minimum booking or request lead time is stated in the reviewed policy; request shipment-specific timing from the airline.
bookingMethod: Ordinary pets travel as Cathay Cargo manifest shipments. For direct bookings accepted from 2025-09-01 onward, the booking party must be an IPATA or ATA member, an IATA-accredited freight forwarder, or a holder of valid IATA Live Animals Regulations training.

bookingTiming: Contact China Airlines at least 48 hours before departure; acceptance is subject to flight and aircraft limits.
bookingMethod: Reserve through China Airlines. Ordinary household cats and dogs travel only as checked baggage on China Airlines- or Mandarin Airlines-operated flights; immediate transfer to another airline is not accepted.

bookingTiming: Request service at least 48 hours before departure after buying the ticket; approval is required.
bookingMethod: Request pet transport from Korean Air. A passenger may normally carry one pet in the cabin and two in the hold, subject to aircraft and route limits.

bookingTiming: Advance reservation is required. ANA directs passengers departing in four or more days to its message service and those departing within three days to contact ANA; this is a contact channel, not a guaranteed minimum acceptance deadline.
bookingMethod: Reserve with ANA. Checked carriage is limited to ANA flight numbers operated by ANA, subject to aircraft, destination and container acceptance.

bookingTiming: Advance reservation is required and confirmation can take several days. A rental-crate request may be made up to four days before departure, but that is not stated as the transport-booking deadline.
bookingMethod: Reserve the animal with JAL after the passenger booking. Ordinary accompanied animals travel in the hold; unaccompanied animals use JAL Cargo.

bookingTiming: No universal public minimum was established. International pet movements require a Qantas Freight-approved pet-travel specialist and shipment-specific booking.
bookingMethod: Book international pet freight through an approved pet-travel specialist. Pets are not ordinary cabin or checked baggage on international Qantas services.

bookingTiming: Register the pet within 24 hours after completing the passenger booking. More than two pets requires Air Canada Cargo contact 7-14 days before travel.
bookingMethod: Call Air Canada after booking. Acceptance applies only to Air Canada-, Air Canada Rouge- or Air Canada Express-operated services identified by the policy; codeshare partners set their own rules.
